title.narrative: Arab Fact Checkers Network (AFCN) Innovation & Resilience

description.narrative: Adopting a regional approach that brings together fact-checkers from Jordan, the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT), Iraq, Morocco, Tunisia, Yemen and Lebanon, the project aims to stem the dissemination of harmful information and redress the democratic deficit in relation to speech moderation online ¿ with the overall objective of increasing the public¿s as well as policy makers¿ use of locally-driven fact-checked online news media and analysis.
